# --schema --json groups schemas by builtins, provider, and imported module.
bit --schema --json
cp stdout schema.json
exec jq -e '(.builtins.functions | type) == "array"' schema.json
exec jq -e '(.docker.resources | type) == "array"' schema.json
exec jq -e '.tools.resources[0].name == "tools.image"' schema.json
exec jq -e '(.tools.functions | type) == "array"' schema.json

-- BUILD.bit --
import "./tools" as tools
-- tools/image.bit --
param tag: string
